R38 — gen7 equipment: the file-name grammar of the loose `rendering/<family>/` textures / meshes vs the equipment id columns of the
database (PS3 anchors 11–Legacy; the Xbox 360 trees carry the same families). Read-only.

For each equipment family directory (glove, helmet, skate, blocker, trapper, goaliepad, goaliehelmet, goaliestick, playerstick, visor …)
the file names are tokenised as `<prefix>_<n1>[_<n2>[_<n3>]]_<suffix>.rx2|.rpsgl` (suffix = texture kind `dm tm nm sm am csm` or absent for a mesh),
and the set of `n1` (and `n2`) values is compared with the distinct values of every equipment id column of `exhibitionskaterequipment` /
`exhibitiongoalieequipment` / `stockteamequipmenttable` / `stockgoalieequipment`: the column whose value set is best contained in a family's
numbers (and vice versa) is reported as the candidate binding, with the residuals (ids without files, files without ids).
Usage: python r38_gen7_equipment_file_grammar.py <out.json> [--titles legacy,nhl15]
